item.title: Keppel Secures Singapore License for Kruger Cable System
item.summary: Keppel Ltd. (Keppel) and its Connectivity Division’s wholly-owned subsidiary, Keppel Kruger Holdings Pte. Ltd. (KKH), has received a Facilities-Based Operator (FBO) license from Singapore’s Infocomm Media Development Authority (IMDA). This license will enable KKH to own, operate, and maintain telecommunications infrastructure in Singapore and offer services related to the Kruger Cable System (Kruger).
